Create folders for saving objects
```{r Folders, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define folders
folders <- c("results", "results/07_public_data")

# Create folders if they don't exist
lapply(folders, function(f) if (!dir.exists(f)) dir.create(f, recursive = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# 1. Define literature data directly in R (no CSV loading required)
pub_data <- data.frame(
  Citation = c(
    "Zheng et al. 2021",
    "Guo et al. 2021",
    "Ma et al. 2022",
    "Kim et al. 2025",
    "Wu et al. 2023",
    "Li et al. 2023",
    "Jin et al. 2023",
    "Song et al. 2024"
  ),
  Astrocyte.yield = c(
    "~5-10",
    "5.9",
    "8",
    "14",
    "19",
    "2.4",
    "2.6",
    "~15-20"
  ),
  GFAP.astrocytes = c(
    "~30",
    "NI",
    "~40",
    "NI",
    "NI",
    "NI",
    "NI",
    "NI"
  ),
  Astro_Gfap = c(
    "~5-10% (~30%)",
    "5.9% (?)",
    "8% (~40%)",
    "14% (?)",
    "19% (?)",
    "2.4% (?)",
    "2.6% (?)",
    "~15-20% (?)"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Clean yield values (convert ranges to midpoints or keep as is)
astro_data_clean <-pub_data %>%
  mutate(
    Astro_yield_text = Astro_Gfap,  # Save original for labeling
    Astro_yield_num = str_replace_all(Astrocyte.yield, "[^0-9\\-\\.]", ""),
    Astro_yield_num = ifelse(
      str_detect(Astro_yield_num, "-"),
      rowMeans(do.call(rbind, str_split(Astro_yield_num, "-")) %>% apply(2, as.numeric), na.rm = TRUE),
      as.numeric(Astro_yield_num)
    )
  )

astro_data_clean$GFAP.astrocytes_clean <- ifelse(
  astro_data_clean$GFAP.astrocytes == "NI", 
  "?", 
  astro_data_clean$GFAP.astrocytes
)

```

```{r}
plots[["column_pub"]] <- ggplot(astro_data_clean, aes(x = reorder(Citation, Astro_yield_num), y = Astro_yield_num)) +
  
  # --- CHANGED: Added width = 0.6 to increase the spacing between columns ---
  geom_col(
    fill = col_list[["column_plot"]], 
    color = col_list[["borders"]], 
    linewidth = 0.3,                 # Switched 'size' to 'linewidth' to match updated ggplot syntax
    width = 0.7                      # Lower number = wider space between bars (Try 0.5 for even bigger space)
  ) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = Astro_yield_text), vjust = +0.3, size = 1.5, hjust = -0.1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Studies",
    y = expression("Astrocyte yield (% " * italic("Gfap") * "+)")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, 25)) +
  theme_mk +
  NoGrid()

plots[["column_pub"]]


ggsave(
  filename = "results/07_public_data/2V_07_column_pub.tiff",              
  plot = plots[["column_pub"]],          
  device = "tiff",                          
  width = 6,                             
  height = 8,                              
  units = "cm", 
  dpi = 600,            # Sets the high resolution
  compression = "lzw",  # Compresses the file without losing quality
  bg = "white"          # Ensures a solid white background
)
```
